title: Home Goods / Furniture / Interiors
description: A physical-goods vertical that behaves nothing like fast DTC: high ticket, long deliberation, spatial imagination, and a return that costs a freight shipment. Inherits e-commerce mechanics, overrides the psychology.

seasonality.note: Furniture's real peaks are the mattress-and-sofa sale weekends, not BFCM.

objection_library: will it match what I already own
is it comfortable / does it feel cheap
what if it doesn't work — return cost
is it durable with kids or pets

creative.image_style: styled interior with believable daylight from a real window direction, accurate scale against human-sized reference objects, honest material texture (grain, weave, stitch), lived-in not showroom-sterile
creative.image_negative: impossible room geometry, furniture floating off the floor, doorways to nowhere, warped perspective, inconsistent light direction, plants that defy gravity, mismatched shadow angles
creative.video_style: slow considered camera movement, room-scale reveal, close-ups on material and joinery, real hands using the piece
shot_grammar: wide reveal with the piece in place

kpis.note_ref: In long-cycle home goods, saves predict revenue better than clicks do.

plays.title: Before/after room transformation
plays.when: The piece is best understood in context, or the SKU has a weak standalone hero shot.

with.lock: room geometry and light direction across both frames

plays.title: Answer the measurement objection
plays.when: Return data or support tickets point at sizing and fit.

prompt_fragments.voice: Speak like a shop owner who knows the joinery and also knows the buyer has a tape measure and a partner to convince. Practical reassurance beats aspiration.
prompt_fragments.proof_instruction: Dimensions, materials, weight capacity, warranty length and lead time are proof. Use them early — they are the objections in disguise.
prompt_fragments.visual_instruction: Keep one consistent light direction and one consistent room geometry across every frame in a set. Include a human-scale reference. Material texture must be visible at 100% crop.
prompt_fragments.objection_instruction: Name the fit, delivery and durability questions before the buyer has to ask. In this category, unanswered logistics is the number one reason a saved item never converts.
